name: TimeChat-Online-139K
description: TimeChat-Online-139K is a comprehensive streaming video dataset designed for real-time video understanding and interaction with Video Large Language Models. It features diverse interaction patterns such as backward-tracing, current-perception, and future-responding scenarios, enabling evaluation of models' proactive response capabilities in streaming video contexts.
reputation: A recent specialized dataset for streaming video understanding with growing interest in video-LLM research, but not yet broadly established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Includes a novel Differential Token Drop module to reduce visual redundancy and supports real-time video interaction evaluation.
